description: A launch whose claims outrun what the product can defend.

flaws.description: 'No mistakes' is an absolute accuracy claim about an AI feature. It is indefensible and invites the exact story a journalist wants to write.
Design-partner logos are used as customer proof without any stated permission to do so.
'10x faster' rests on 20 internal test files with no methodology anyone outside can check.
Signups measure launch noise, not whether the product works. No activation, retention, or conversion metric.
Front-loaded spend plus a 46k email blast with no stated support or infrastructure readiness.
The only risk considered is a competitor, and the mitigation is 'launch first', which is not a mitigation.
